# STQ Capital

> STQ Capital is an independent registered investment adviser (RIA) serving high-income and high-net-worth investors. The firm specializes in tax-aware portfolio construction and management, with a focus on after-tax returns. Services include direct indexing, tax-loss harvesting, box spread financing, concentrated stock position management, and asset allocation optimization. STQ Capital operates as a fiduciary with no commissions or product sales. More information is available at stqcap.com. Contact: info@stqcap.com. Schedule: https://calendly.com/stqcapital/30min

## Pillar Guides

- [Tax-Aware Investing: The Complete Guide](https://stqcap.com/tax-aware-investing-guide.html): Why after-tax return is the only number that matters, and the core strategies that keep more of what you earn.
- [Tax-Loss Harvesting: Building a Loss Bank](https://stqcap.com/tax-loss-harvesting.html): Done right, harvesting is a year-round engine that banks losses to offset gains for years, not a December chore.
- [Long/Short Tax-Loss Harvesting](https://stqcap.com/long-short-tax-loss-harvesting.html): Long-only harvesting stalls once a portfolio sits on gains. A long/short extension keeps generating losses in any market.
- [Box Spread Borrowing: The Complete Guide](https://stqcap.com/box-spread-borrowing-guide.html): Borrow against a portfolio at near-Treasury rates through the options market. No bank, no credit check, potentially tax-deductible interest.
- [Box Spread Financing](https://stqcap.com/box-spreads.html): Live benchmark rates and how STQ implements box spread borrowing.
- [How Direct Indexing Works](https://stqcap.com/how-direct-indexing-works.html): Own the individual stocks inside an index, harvest losses at the security level, customize everything.
- [What to Do With a Concentrated Stock Position](https://stqcap.com/concentrated-stock-positions.html): Six tools to diversify, hedge, monetize, and give, almost none requiring a taxable sale.
- [Asset Location](https://stqcap.com/asset-location.html): The same investments in different account types can produce dramatically different after-tax outcomes.

## Key Insights

- [Long/Short Tax-Loss Harvesting: The Engine That Does Not Run Dry](https://stqcap.com/insights/insight-long-short-tax-loss-harvesting.html): Why long-only harvesting ossifies and how a short book fixes it.
- [Volatility Is the Price of Stocks. Get Paid Back.](https://stqcap.com/insights/insight-volatility-tax-asset.html): How direct indexing turns market swings into a banked tax asset.
- [351 Exchange or Exchange Fund?](https://stqcap.com/insights/insight-351-vs-exchange-fund.html): Two tax-free ways to diversify a concentrated position, compared.
- [The Bank Will Sell You a VPF. Here Is Why We Build It.](https://stqcap.com/insights/insight-synthetic-vpf-vs-bank.html): Synthetic variable prepaid forward (collar plus box spread) vs the bank's packaged version.
- [PPLI: A Tax-Free Wrapper for Your Most-Taxed Assets](https://stqcap.com/insights/insight-ppli.html): Private placement life insurance for hedge funds and private credit.
- [All Insights](https://stqcap.com/insights.html): Full library of STQ Capital insights on tax strategy, box spreads, direct indexing, and portfolio construction.
